consequence.statement: The line describes adding digest pinning to image automation testing only, and states no effect on running clusters, existing resources or configuration; there is nothing an operator must do.

assertion.statement: The flux 2.7.0 release notes state that digest pinning was added to image automation testing (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5383); the single changelog line names no user-facing surface and describes no effect on existing environments.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The release-note line names only the feature area 'digest pinning' within image automation testing; it does not identify a concrete product surface (CRD field, Helm value, flag, image, config key or behavior) the addition attaches to.; applicability: The line identifies no environment-visible surface or setting (no values key, resource field, flag, image or behavior), so no exposure condition can be expressed for a customer environment.
